requirements.text: Real-time notifications triggered by account transactions, including transaction details and alerts for important account activities.
Biometric authentication using fingerprint and facial recognition to enhance security and user convenience.
Instant card controls allowing users to freeze and unfreeze cards, set spending limits, and receive real-time transaction alerts.
In-app lending and credit applications with a straightforward process, pre-qualification options, and transparent information about terms.
System must comply with PSD2, GDPR, and Central Bank regulations throughout all features.
Implement biometric authentication to eliminate the risk associated with traditional passwords.
Provide timely, relevant information through real-time notifications to empower customers to manage their finances effectively.
Ensure a user-friendly process for in-app lending while maintaining compliance and ensuring customers are fully informed.
